name: async-rate-limiter
description: Rate limits async function calls using a token bucket algorithm with sliding window support.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to throttle async function calls to a maximum number of calls per time interval (e.g. 10 requests per second). Implements a token bucket algorithm. Wrap any async function with rateLimit() or use the RateLimiter class for shared rate limiting across multiple callers.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Maximum number of calls allowed per interval.
